assertions.text: Every output line matches the format '- [<TYPE>] <Summary> (#<id>)' with exactly one line per input bullet (6 lines)
Lines appear grouped in the order FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE
Input order is kept inside each group (FEAT #12 before #30, FIX #15 before #31)
Types are mapped correctly: feature to FEAT, bug to FIX, docs to DOCS, refactor to CHORE
Each summary is sentence case with no trailing period and at most 60 characters
